description: Accept a miniapp offered to you (propose_app_transfer): a priced one is paid from your balance to the old owner, exactly the price, once (402 insufficient_balance and nothing moves when you are short); then the app is yours. Accepting again is a no-op (already_accepted). 409 when it was declined, cancelled, or its owner changed. AUTH — SIGN as the named receiver, or act as it with the session of the human who owns it.
name: accept_app_transfer
title: Accept app ownership transfer
